_comments: WHERE A PRODUCT'S GL ACCOUNTS COME FROM (golive#439). Its own dot-json so it conflicts with no other
change to the remote operations. Called by the product's Accounting tab so its Effective accounts block
shows the walk confirm books through, not a copy of it.

fields.Name: Explain Product GL Accounts
fields.Description: For one product, company and day: which GL account each role books to (Sales, Deferred Revenue, Sales Discounts, Sales Returns and Allowances, Accounts Receivable by default) and every level the walk tried — the product, its category and the category's parents, its product type, and the company default — with the winning level marked. A role that resolves nowhere, or whose winning account belongs to other books, carries the refusal confirm would give. Read-only. Runs the same walk confirm books through, so the product screen cannot disagree with booking.
